newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO SAYS CU RUMOURS "OLD STUFF".
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO SAYS CU RUMOURS "OLD STUFF".

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO said on Friday it would not comment on market rumours it might be considering a bid for British insurer Commercial Union, which it said were nothing new.
"We do not comment on these types of rumour," Spokesman Jules Prast said. "Besides, this is old stuff. Every summer we seem to hear this particular story."

ABN AMRO shares topped the volume list on the Amsterdam stock exchange on Friday, trading up 1.80 guilders, or 4.2 percent, at 44.70 guilders by 0850 GMT. The AEX headline share index was up around 1.1 percent.
"We know that we are seen to be quite acquisitive," Prast said. "But it seems whenever anything comes up people start to talk about us."
